newsitem.title: UK: UK housing starts rise 4.0 pct in 3 mths to Dec.
newsitem.headline: UK housing starts rise 4.0 pct in 3 mths to Dec.

text.p: UK housing starts rose 4.0 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to December from the previous three, while total completions were little changed, the Department of the Environment said on Tuesday.
In the latest three months, a total of 41,100 dwellings were started, up 25 percent on the same three months a year ago. Completions totalled 47,300 and were up one percent from a year ago.
Private enterprise housing starts were up 7.0 percent and completions were up one percent.
Housing association starts and completions of new dwellings were both lower than during the previous three months.
Both starts and completions by local authorities and government departments remained at a low level, the DOE said.
